name: Via Mariae M05 - The Central-European Pilgrimway
description_md:
Via Mariae M05 - The Central-European Pilgrimway is a waymarked hiking route in RO signposted as M05. It belongs to an international waymarked hiking network and is classified as easy due to the distance and ascent.

This trail spans a distance of 392.9 km with 8485 m of ascent and 8037 m of descent. Walkers should plan for about 120 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The route passes Teleki House, Târgu Mureș within 1200 m, Targu Mures within 1200 m, and Târgu-Mureş within 1700 m.
